learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the secret detective skills to read, understand, and easily answer questions from brand new stories and passages!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Skimming is like flying a helicopter over a forest. You do not look at every single tree, you just look at the titles, pictures, and first sentences to get the main idea of the story really fast!
Scanning is when you play detective! You read the questions first, pick out important words like names, dates, or places, and then hunt for those exact words inside the passage.
Sometimes the answer is not written directly in the text. You have to use the clues given by the author and your own smart brain to figure out how a character feels or why something happened.

fun_activity.title: 🕵️‍♂️ The Five Ws Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Pick up today's newspaper or any storybook. Read one short paragraph and try to find the answers to the 5 Ws (Who, What, Where, When, Why) in under two minutes!

quick_recap: ⭐ Skim the passage quickly first to understand what it is generally about.
⭐ Read the questions carefully and scan the text to hunt for specific facts, dates, and keywords.
